blocks.text: Andrea Brillantes and Heart Evangelista stole the spotlight at the annual Shake, Rattle & Ball Halloween party, as the former embraced a daring nude look while the latter sported a bloodied, knife-adorned costume. Held at a hotel in Pasay City on Saturday, Oct. 31, the Halloween ball, organized by Tim Yap, carried the theme “LUCID: Dreams and Nightmares,” with the dress code invitation, “Come as a dream. Come as a nightmare.” Brillantes embraced a common nightmare of being caught naked in public with her daring “Tabloid Nakedness” look.
